original.statement: Istio components now read v1 CRDs where applicable; no impact unless the cluster uses Istio CRDs from 1.21 or older, which is an unsupported version skew.

decision.reason: [ev-9fb93117372e] says all Istio components were updated to read `v1` CRDs "where applicable". Your configuration stays the same; only the API version the components read from the API server changes. That makes behavior-changed the right change type. The note names no specific kind or field, so a free-form protocol-behavior subject built from the note's own words ("v1-crd-read") fits the rules, and the assertion is acceptable as stated.
